scope: Three selected PVS entrypoints and their loaded Project/required original Native dependency closure. This is an incremental normal replay, not a whole-library replay or a proof of binary64 execution, sensor calibration, C20 identity, or universal inverse curvature/coherence ordering.

native_inputs.identity_encoding: Native name, relative source path/SHA256, relative proof path/SHA256, input-kind; repeated actual occurrences retained. Digest: SHA256 UTF8 compact JSON rows sorted by compact JSON encoding, ensure_ascii=false.
native_inputs.metadata_scope: 130 metadata slots in44files only; source statements and proof programs unchanged. Installed libraries were not modified.

algorithm.coherence: Clipped dot product of first and last unit steps computed from the SAME ordered fixed-map vertex coordinates as angular curvature. It is not coupling C20.
algorithm.positive_result: For an active three-sample walk, curvature equals acos(endpoint coherence) divided by the first-step length. Concrete normalized prefix witness has curvature0 and coherence1.
algorithm.counterexample: Two actual four-sample PPG paths under one fixed map/common graph share endpoints,first step,step-length multiset and arclength sqrt(2); highpath has curvature3*pi/(2*sqrt(2)) and coherence1, lowpath pi/sqrt(2) and coherence0. Both quantities increase, disproving universal inverse ordering.
algorithm.report_contract: Both reported fields must equal the computations; actual path,len>=3,active steps and user bounds are required. Samewalk/fixedmap preservation under pp_transform is proved.
algorithm.boundary: Exact real arithmetic with cutoff1/10^10; no floating-point execution refinement or physical Lie representation is asserted.

reproduction.library_setup: Use pinned NASAlib plus the published metadata compatibility tool and include installation/lib in PVS_LIBRARY_PATH.
reproduction.note: Recorded run selected all three in one unchanged public run_worker session. Each command independently replays its loaded Project and required Native dependency closure.
